title: feat: cloud worker runner, plugin build and one-time owner grant
headline: Cloud workers run only five fixed jobs through a runner that stops them at a wrong start; the owner's card yes becomes a one-time grant for one held call; the release builds into a guarded plugin; and each score gate arm is graded on its own global instructions.
alignment: v1.50.0 is build 23b of the v2.0 plan: K177, K216, K219, T12 with E24, K176, K175, E36, K174, K179, K230, K232, K231 and the T2 cues, each test seen failing first. K178 is in, on the owner's yes.

items.text: Recall and behaviour sessions start with `--strict-mcp-config`, so an MCP server listed in the probe project no longer joins a scored session.
The settings-change guard blocks when it cannot run: its hook entry says `onFailure: block`, the wiring check asks for it, and a check that throws holds the change and names the cause.
items.where: A settings change while the settings check is broken
items.test: tests/launcher-verify.test.mjs::a settings check that throws holds the change with the cause named (K216)

items.text: The global instructions name the three arrow code points they ban by number, and the year line says the rules are current as of the session date instead of a fixed year range.
items.test: tests/kit-rules.test.mjs::the arrow rule bans none of the spellings it requires, and no instruction pins a year range (K219)

items.text: A where-work-runs rule and a worker brief template name the five jobs that may run in the cloud; the rule, the brief, the sweep approval refusal and the runner hold one list.
items.test: tests/kit-rules.test.mjs::the where-work-runs rule, the cloud refusals and the worker brief name one job list (T12)

items.text: The worker runner starts only a job on the fixed list, and names the list when it refuses one.
items.test: tests/worker.test.mjs::the runner starts only a job on the fixed list, and names the list when it refuses (T12)

items.text: The worker runner hands the worker only allow-listed variables, drops tokens and preload options, and always sets the cloud marker.
items.test: tests/worker.test.mjs::the worker env keeps only the allow-listed variables and always carries the cloud marker

items.text: The worker starts `claude -p` with the pinned plugin folder, user and project settings only, `--strict-mcp-config` and the default permission mode.
items.test: tests/worker.test.mjs::the worker starts claude -p with every fixed flag and the pinned plugin

items.text: The worker runner refuses main, master, the default branch, a tag and a badly named branch.
items.test: tests/worker.test.mjs::main, master, the default branch, a tag and a badly named branch are refused

items.text: The worker runner refuses to start outside the cloud or on a refused branch, before it starts anything.
items.where: A worker run on the PC or on main
items.test: tests/worker.test.mjs::the runner refuses outside the cloud and on a refused branch, before any spawn

items.text: A worker run goes to the end in its own worktree and config folder, with the scrubbed variables, a set folder and a time limit.
items.test: tests/worker.test.mjs::a good stream runs to the end in its own worktree with the scrubbed env, a cwd and a timeout

items.text: The start check reads the kit start-up line from plain hook output or the hook JSON, and only at the start of a line.
items.test: tests/worker.test.mjs::the start check reads the line from plain hook stdout or the kit hook JSON, and only at a line start

items.test: tests/owner-grant.test.mjs::K176 a grant binds one session, one tool and the exact act

verification: Every new test fails first on the 1.49.0 code, on an assertion; the test check reports no finding.
A live plugin session named the plugin root and `/kit:methodology-kit` at start, held a push to main, and the runner stopped a plugin with its hooks removed.
Pending: the score gate run of record on the owner's PC, recall and behaviour.

decisions.decision: The Q13 cue is left out
decisions.why: A cloud trial tied 5 of 5 against 5 of 5; the owner's pick (2026-11-21).

decisions.decision: A grant lifts one hold, once, for the main session only
decisions.why: A card yes names one act; a helper session has no card.

decisions.decision: The worker runner refuses outside the cloud
decisions.why: Workers run only in the cloud, by the where-work-runs rule.
New tools, a new rule and new holds reach every project.

upgrading: Run install user, then install project: the launcher, owner-proof, the start-up hook, the global instructions, the team rules, the worker brief template and the new kit tools worker.mjs, grant.mjs, owner-grant.cjs and plugin-launch.cjs change.
limits: The git pre-push hook reads its own yes record, not grants, so a granted push past the bound is still held there. A program, not a tool call, that writes a whole new grant file is not stopped: the grant hash catches slips, not an attacker. The global instructions do not reach a plugin session. On a machine whose own global instructions load beside the arm's, the score keeps its Not measured line.
